name: Zombie_1
short_caption: The robot acts like a zombie, raising its arms forward with limp hands before returning to rest.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture, slowly raising both arms forward and upward while tilting its head to the side. Its hands droop limply from the wrists as it mimics a classic zombie posture, shifting its torso slightly. Finally, it slowly lowers its arms back down to its sides and brings its head back to a centered, neutral position.
safety_notes: The robot extends both arms forward at chest height. Ensure there is clear space directly in front of the robot.
